The **University of St Andrews** ([Scots](/wiki/Scots_language "Scots language"): *University o St Andras*, [Scottish Gaelic](/wiki/Scottish_Gaelic_language "Scottish Gaelic language"): *Oilthigh Chill Rìmhinn*;[[6]](#cite_note-6) abbreviated as **St And** in [post-nominals](/wiki/Post-nominals "Post-nominals")[[a]](#cite_note-7)) is a [public](/wiki/Public_university "Public university") [research university](/wiki/Research_university "Research university") in the town of [St Andrews](/wiki/St_Andrews "St Andrews") in [Scotland](/wiki/Scotland "Scotland"). It is the [oldest](/wiki/List_of_oldest_universities_in_continuous_operation "List of oldest universities in continuous operation") of the four [ancient universities of Scotland](/wiki/Ancient_universities_of_Scotland "Ancient universities of Scotland") and, following the universities of [Oxford](/wiki/University_of_Oxford "University of Oxford") and [Cambridge](/wiki/University_of_Cambridge "University of Cambridge"), the third-oldest university in the [English-speaking world](/wiki/English-speaking_world "English-speaking world"). St Andrews was founded in 1413 when the [Avignon](/wiki/Avignon_Pope "Avignon Pope") [Antipope Benedict XIII](/wiki/Antipope_Benedict_XIII "Antipope Benedict XIII") issued a [papal bull](/wiki/Papal_bull "Papal bull") to a small founding group of [Augustinian](/wiki/Augustinians "Augustinians") clergy. Along with the universities of [Glasgow](/wiki/University_of_Glasgow "University of Glasgow"), [Aberdeen](/wiki/University_of_Aberdeen "University of Aberdeen"), and [Edinburgh](/wiki/University_of_Edinburgh "University of Edinburgh"), St Andrews was part of the [Scottish Enlightenment](/wiki/Scottish_Enlightenment "Scottish Enlightenment") during the 18th century.

Navraj Singh Goraya was born on November 3, 1989, in [Toronto](/wiki/Toronto "Toronto"), Ontario, into a poor immigrant [Punjabi](/wiki/Punjabi_Canadians "Punjabi Canadians") [Sikh](/wiki/Sikhs "Sikhs") family, from [Punjab](/wiki/Punjab,_India "Punjab, India"), India. He was raised in the [Rexdale](/wiki/Rexdale "Rexdale") neighbourhood. His mother was involved in computer manufacturing and his father operated a forklift.[[1]](#cite_note-:0-1) Nav first became interested in music after his mother bought him a boombox in the third grade.[[2]](#cite_note-2) His uncle was also a [popular Punjabi singer](/wiki/Music_of_Punjab#Punjabi_pop "Music of Punjab") in India and brought him to a studio.[[3]](#cite_note-3) He began making mash-ups in high school and producing beats for local underground Toronto artists, and became popular on [SoundCloud](/wiki/SoundCloud "SoundCloud"). Nav first started producing using [Sony](/wiki/Sony "Sony")'s [ACID Pro](/wiki/ACID_Pro "ACID Pro") software.[[1]](#cite_note-:0-1) He attended West Humber Junior Middle School and then later attended [Thistletown Collegiate Institute](/wiki/Thistletown_Collegiate_Institute "Thistletown Collegiate Institute") for his high school education and had to spend an additional year to graduate. Following high school, he attended and graduated from [Metalworks Institute](/wiki/Metalworks_Institute "Metalworks Institute") in [Mississauga](/wiki/Mississauga "Mississauga"), Ontario, in 2010 with a diploma in Audio Production and Engineering.[[4]](#cite_note-4)

Main article: [macOS Ventura](/wiki/MacOS_Ventura "MacOS Ventura")

[macOS Ventura](/wiki/MacOS_Ventura "MacOS Ventura") was announced during the WWDC keynote speech on June 6, 2022[[233]](#cite_note-238) and released on October 24, 2022.[[234]](#cite_note-239) It came with the redesigned System Preferences (named System Settings) to a more [iOS](/wiki/IOS "IOS")-like design, and the new [Freeform](/wiki/Freeform_(Apple) "Freeform (Apple)"), [Weather](/wiki/Weather_(Apple) "Weather (Apple)") and [Clock](/wiki/Clock_(Apple) "Clock (Apple)") apps that run natively on Mac. Users can use an iPhone as a webcam for video conferencing with Continuity Camera. Siri's appearance was changed to look more like the versions on [iOS 14](/wiki/IOS_14 "IOS 14") and [iPadOS 14](/wiki/IPadOS_14 "IPadOS 14"). [Mail](/wiki/Apple_Mail "Apple Mail") introduced schedule send and undo send for emails, and [Message](/wiki/IMessage "IMessage") also got the ability to undo send and edit messages. Stage Manager was introduced as a new way to organize all open windows in a desktop. [Maps](/wiki/Apple_Maps "Apple Maps") gained the feature for multiple-stop routes, [Metal 3](/wiki/Metal_(API) "Metal (API)") was added with support for spatial and temporal image upscaling, Lockdown Mode was added to reduce the risk of a cyberattack, and the ability to play ambient background sounds was added as an accessibility feature in System Settings.

Lithium-7 was created in nuclear reactions very early in the history of the universe, in a process called [Big Bang nucleosynthesis](/wiki/Big_Bang_nucleosynthesis "Big Bang nucleosynthesis"). The relative amount of lithium was small compared to isotopes of hydrogen and helium. The only other element created was beryllium-7 which decayed into lithium-7. Measured lithium abundance does not match the nucleosynthesis model well, an issue called "[cosmological lithium problem](/wiki/Cosmological_lithium_problem "Cosmological lithium problem");" whether this is due to issues in the difficult experimental measurements or in aspects of the theory is not known. Measurements of primordial lithium abundance are complicated because lithium-7 can be created and destroyed in cosmic ray, [classical nova](/wiki/Classical_nova "Classical nova"), and [supernova](/wiki/Supernova "Supernova") reactions, and inside stars. The only known mechanism to produce lithium-6 is via cosmic-ray interactions.[[32]](#cite_note-Cyburt-2016-32)

Lithium is also found in [brown dwarf](/wiki/Brown_dwarf "Brown dwarf") substellar objects.
